scope: Frozen-geometry CPU numerical validation, not experimental calibration, global branch selection, endpoint or accelerator promotion.

gates.note: Recommendation additionally requires a passing current CPU test suite and review of all classified failures.

provenance.note: Per-run source hashes match. Early raw rows predate additional metadata/error fields; absent fields are not reconstructed.

limitations: Numerical validity is not branch consistency; callers must audit the actual sequence, geometry, precision and pH grid.
Case 100 exhausts the forward budget for some samples; invalid gradients remain unusable.
Sampled-path disagreement is retained, including large gaps on case 212; no branch is automatically selected.
Small float32 audit gaps near the threshold can reflect finite-solve error; higher precision requires a fresh audit.
Compiler temporary-memory reduction is not process RSS reduction. Timings use heterogeneous CPU hosts.
